response.original_title: I Wanna Be With You Everywhere
response.overview: Recognizing that, due to a lack of access, disability communities are often barred from cultural institutions and social resources, an artist collective produces uniquely accessible events for an ever-expanding vision of a cross-disability community. Capturing them at work and at play, this film embraces the collective’s commitment to an aesthetics that incorporates collectively made creative access while highlighting integrated audio description, open captioning, descriptive audio narration, and ASL interpretation integrated into the film itself.
response.title: I Wanna Be With You Everywhere
